description: Wire pricing card buttons to assign token credits with login gate for unauthenticated users

userStories.title: Wire pricing buttons to POST /api/user/assign-plan
userStories.description: Add click handlers to the Get Free, Lite Subscribe, and Pro Subscribe buttons in Pricing.js that call POST /api/user/assign-plan with the correct plan mapping: Get Free=free, Lite Subscribe=tier2, Pro Subscribe=tier3. Use authenticatedFetch from src/utils/api.js and getToken from useAuth().
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Get Free' button calls POST /api/user/assign-plan with plan=free
Clicking 'Lite Subscribe' button calls POST /api/user/assign-plan with plan=tier2
Clicking 'Pro Subscribe' button calls POST /api/user/assign-plan with plan=tier3
getToken is obtained from useAuth() hook

userStories.title: Open LoginModal if user is unauthenticated when clicking a pricing button
userStories.description: Before calling assign-plan, check if the user is signed in using useUser/useAuth from Clerk. If not authenticated, open the LoginModal instead of making the API call.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated user clicking any pricing button sees LoginModal instead of API call
Authenticated user clicking any pricing button proceeds to POST /api/user/assign-plan
Uses useAuth or useUser from @clerk/clerk-react to check auth state
